thermal_activity.method: FIRMS point-detection quality summary; AOI-bounded coordinates; confidence classes; haversine distance to crater centre
limitations: A FIRMS detection is a satellite hotspot pixel, not a measured crater temperature or flame perimeter.
No detection does not demonstrate that the crater was inactive; overpass timing, cloud, pixel size and detection thresholds limit observation.
NRT and standard-processing products can differ; platform, product family and query dates must be retained.
Spatial distance from the crater centre is descriptive and is not a crater-footprint boundary.

products.title: Crater perimeter segmentation
evidence: High-resolution orthorectified reference imagery at <=5 m (prefer <=1 m)
Two independent expert delineations and reviewer sign-off
IoU, Dice, boundary F1 and Hausdorff-distance report
products.notes: Sentinel-2 candidate polygons are exploratory. The 20 m B11/SCL bands are resampled to a 10 m grid.

products.title: Crater area and boundary uncertainty
evidence: Reference area in a projected metric CRS
Boundary perturbation / positional-error model and area confidence interval
products.notes: Candidate algorithm min/median/max is sensitivity analysis, not a confidence interval.

products.title: Sentinel-1 RTC backscatter
evidence: Independent RTC processing of the same S1 GRD acquisitions or a second authoritative RTC provider
Geolocation control points and VV/VH radiometric comparison
Incidence-angle / terrain / border-noise QA with documented tolerances
products.notes: Microsoft Planetary Computer supplies upstream RTC; local processing clips and converts linear power to dB.

products.title: Landsat optical indices and ST_B10
evidence: Independent surface-temperature reference or suitable independent thermal product
Stable-target reflectance checks and cloud/shadow QA audit
Cross-date co-registration and independent change reference
products.notes: ST_B10 is land-surface temperature, not flame or crater-core temperature.

products.title: Before/after and spectral change products
evidence: Independent high-resolution reference for each date pair
Co-registration residuals on stable control features
Confusion / error assessment of change classes
products.notes: Index differences are screening signals, not proof of physical crater growth.

products.title: FIRMS VIIRS/MODIS hotspot detections
evidence: Comparison against an independent active-fire dataset or ground observation log
Overpass, cloud, pixel-size and detection-limit assessment
products.notes: Zero detections means none were returned in the queried windows; it does not prove inactivity or a zero temperature.

scientific_validation.interpretation: Automated tests, raster metadata checks, repeated CI runs and internal cross-sensor consistency do not independently validate the scientific interpretation.
scientific_validation.release_rule: Do not label any product independently validated until its product-specific evidence is attached, reviewed and its validation report passes.

crater_segmentation.method: Sentinel-2 L2A spectral feature threshold ensemble; connected components constrained to a central search zone
crater_segmentation.area_interpretation: Candidate mask area sensitivity only; not a validated crater area.

independent_validation.reason: No independently annotated high-resolution reference polygon and metadata have been supplied.

limitations: Sentinel-2 has no thermal band; no flame/crater-core temperature is inferred.
The centre and 220 m search radius are approximate and can bias component selection.
The 20 m B11/SCL bands are resampled to a 10 m output grid; this does not create 10 m SWIR information.
Area min/median/max/std describe sensitivity to algorithm and thresholds only, not a confidence interval.
Independent validation requires a separately acquired high-resolution reference polygon and independent annotation.
